podcast.title: Formation of "Onda Siniestra" Pioneer (1981)
podcast.body: Décima Víctima formed in 1981, becoming another major band of the initial phase of the "onda siniestra" in Spain. Their sound was described as extremely cold and dark, drawing parallels to Joy Division. "Al igual que para el Isis permanente y Gabinete Caligari, en 1981 también se formó la otra gran banda de la primera etapa de la onda siniestra, décima víctima."

srcs.episode: La España Siniestra ｜ La edad de oro del Postpunk y el Dark wave

podcast.title: Existentialist Lyrics and The Cure Comparison
podcast.body: Carlos Entrena's lyrics were a blend of existentialism and depression, contributing to a melancholic and angst-ridden atmosphere in their music. This lyrical style drew comparisons to The Cure's album "Faith." "Las letras de Entrena, entre existencialistas y depresivas, aportaban ese ambiente melancólico y angustioso que los emparejaban con el Faith de Dickyour."

srcs.episode: La España Siniestra ｜ La edad de oro del Postpunk y el Dark wave

podcast.title: Founding of Grabaciones Accidentales (GASA)
podcast.body: The band established their own label, Grabaciones Accidentales (GASA), in collaboration with Paco Trinidad and members of Esclarecidos. This label was created to self-release their material and became a significant platform for other scene artists. "Ellos también crearon su sello para editar su propio material. Ravaciones accidentales, abreviado como gasa, fundado junto con paco trinidad y miembros desclarecidos."

srcs.episode: La España Siniestra ｜ La edad de oro del Postpunk y el Dark wave

podcast.title: Joy Division Influence and Distinctive Sound
podcast.body: The band was notably close in style to Joy Division and possessed arguably the coldest and darkest sound within the "onda siniestra." Their music was minimalist and characterized by a melancholic and anxious atmosphere. "una banda muy cercana a Joey División y posiblemente los que tenían el sonido más frío y oscuro."

srcs.episode: La España Siniestra ｜ La edad de oro del Postpunk y el Dark wave

podcast.title: Minimalist Aesthetic and Rejection of "Siniestro" Look
podcast.body: Décima Víctima was known for its minimalist approach, consistently dressing austerely and rejecting the characteristic "siniestro" look, differentiating them from other bands of the movement. "Pciaezo era una banda minimalista y siempre vestían de forma austera, renegando del look característico de los iniestros."
